'''Tarik Glenn''' (born May 25, 1976) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was an [[offensive tackle]] for 10 seasons with the [[Indianapolis Colts]] of the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[California Golden Bears football|California Golden Bears]] and was selected by the Colts in the first round of the [[1997 NFL draft]]. Glenn made three [[Pro Bowl]]s and was a part of the Colts team that beat the [[Chicago Bears]] in [[Super Bowl XLI]].
